text: Cambridge 1.30 1.02 Expected 0.03 17.13 0.17 9.57 Somerville The project team further examined the detailed information about the nighttime crashes after midnight in Cambridge on the analyzed C1 roadways. Table 26 and Table 27, for example, show the nighttime crash counts by manner of collision and first harmful event, respectively, for the crashes after midnight for the after-LED conversion period (i.e., 2015–2019) on the analyzed C1 roadways in Cambridge. For the analyzed C1 roadways, the data showed no fatal crashes in Cambridge for the 5-year LED analysis period. Among the crashes, in addition, about a third were injury crashes (including 10 or 6.7% incapacitating injury cases).
